kinds.d: Balance made to weigh small samples precisely.
Thermometer made to read the temperature of a sample, liquid-in-glass or digital probe.
Device that mixes a liquid with a stirring bar or paddle, often with a heating plate; home brewers use one for yeast starters.
Small benchtop machine that spins sample tubes to separate their parts.
Chamber that holds samples at a set warm temperature.

kinds.a: laminar-flow cabinet · clean bench · flow hood
kinds.d: Cabinet that blows HEPA-filtered air over the work surface to keep samples free of contamination; mushroom growers use small ones.
m: Airstream Horizontal Laminar Flow Cabinet LHG

notes: Research-grade SKUs dropped: balance 10 to 3 (Cubis II, Entris II, Explorer, labForce, Accuris Precision); stirrer 9 to 4; centrifuge renamed Mini centrifuge and cut from 50 floor/benchtop research models (Beckman Allegra/Avanti, Sorvall, Megafuge, Hettich, Hermle, Cytospin, larger Eppendorfs) to 3 small units; incubator dropped BINDER and Heratherm lines (9 to 3); laminar-flow hood 6 to 2.
